# awscc_fms_applications_list (Resource)

Creates an AWS Firewall Manager applications list.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `apps_list` (Attributes List) An array of applications in the Firewall Manager applications list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps_list))
- `list_name` (String) The name of the Firewall Manager applications list.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to the applications list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the applications list.
- `create_time` (String) The time that the Firewall Manager applications list was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_update_time` (String) The time that the Firewall Manager applications list was last updated.
- `list_id` (String) The ID of the Firewall Manager applications list.

<a id="nestedatt--apps_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps_list`

Required:

- `app_name` (String) The application's name.
- `port` (Number) The application's port number, for example 80.
- `protocol` (String) The IP protocol name or number. The name can be one of tcp, udp, or icmp. For information on possible numbers, see Protocol Numbers (https://www.iana.org/assignments/protocol-numbers/protocol-numbers.xhtml).


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_fms_applications_list.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the applications list

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_fms_applications_list.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
